name: Satellite Thermal Balance Structural Composition
description: Total thermal dissipation is structurally composed from electronic component heat sources: OBC, comms, ADCS, and battery. Structural UPR: total CZ is Minkowski sum of four component CZs.

consistency_relations.expression: Q_total = P_obc + P_pa + P_adcs + P_batt <= Q_rad_max
consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σᵢ(Pᵢ) = Pᵢ for i=obc,pa,adcs,batt; CZ_total = ⊕ᵢ CZᵢ (Minkowski sum of four independent CZs)
